description: This header file defines interfaces and constants related to radio operating standards management within a radio device software stack. It includes function declarations for updating and checking radio standards, as well as a callback for handling parameter changes.
external_methods: swla/swla_radioStandards.h (implicitly providing definitions related to swl_radStd_m and swl_radStd_e)

methods.name: wld_rad_update_operating_standard
methods.description: Updates the radio's operating standard based on the provided radio context and transaction.

methods.name: wld_rad_getEnabledRadStd
methods.description: Returns a bitmask of enabled radio standards based on supported list and user selection, defaulting to legacy standards if no match.

methods.name: wld_rad_checkEnabledRadStd
methods.description: Checks whether a specific radio standard is enabled for the given radio context.

methods.name: wld_rad_handleOperStdsAndFormatNewValues
methods.description: Callback to handle parameter changes related to operating standards and formats, updating the radio configuration accordingly.
